basis: The task requires using the Factory F production dashboard as the evidence source. The plotted line on the dashboard shows a net decrease in production, starting at 3,500 in 2018 and ending at approximately 2,050 in 2023. This visual evidence of a downward trend contradicts the chart's title ('Increasing Production...'), but the task instructions prioritize the dashboard view. The 'Route to production decline response' option aligns with the observed net decrease in the production data.
